name: CBS housing costs by municipality (85950NED)

measures.definition: Median monthly rent paid by households renting a home under 75 m² from a private landlord (not a housing corporation), after any rent benefit.
Median monthly rent paid by households renting a home of 75 to 100 m² from a private landlord (not a housing corporation), after any rent benefit.

rights.attribution: Source: CBS (Statistics Netherlands), Woonlasten huishoudens; kenmerken huishouden, woning, gemeente (85950NED), CC BY 4.0

vetted.notes: Official, CC BY 4.0. Private landlords only: housing-corporation homes go through waiting lists a newcomer cannot use.

caveats: Every private tenancy, sitting tenants included, and net of rent benefit; size bands, not bedrooms (under 75 m² for one bedroom, 75 to 100 m² for three).
CBS leaves out a figure it cannot publish reliably, so a city may show an earlier year than another.
